snippet.description:
너무 막 만들어서 레시피는 그냥 따로 적을게..ㅎ
(근데 요상하게 맛은 있었다고 한다.)
 
1. 버터와 우유를 약불/전자레인지로 녹여(끓이지 않게) 미지근하게 준비합니다.
2. 달걀, 설탕, 소금을 섞고, 버터우유를 조금씩 넣어가며 반죽을 풀어줍니다.
3. 찹쌀가루(필요 시 타피오카전분)와 베이킹파우더를 체에 내려 넣고, 덩어리 없이 매끈하게 섞습니다.
4. 버터를 바른 틀에 80 ~ 90%만 채워 굽습니다.
5. 오븐: 170 ~ 200℃에서 25 ~ 40분, 에어프라이어: 160 ~ 175℃에서 20 ~ 35분을 기준으로 색/중앙 탄력으로 조절합니다.

참고로 버터떡은 따뜻하게 먹어야 맛있는 것 같아요!
상하이에서 차갑게 식은 버터떡 먹었는데 그건 맛이 없어서 왜 유행이지? 했는데

* 메뉴2: 荔枝冰酿·非遗经典款
    * 특징: 리치 티 / 저당 / 차 젤리

가게명: 满记甜品 (상해 신세계점)
* 메뉴: 固体杨枝甘露 PRO MAX
 총평(⭐️)

6. 27:31 (마라새우만두)

* 메뉴1: 鲜虾蟹籽云吞
    * 특징: 새우+게알 완탕 / 매운 소스
총평(⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️)

7. 30:24 (수건케이크)
가게명: DRUNK BAKER (상해 恒丰路점)
* 메뉴: 黑巧脆皮提拉米苏毛巾卷
    * 특징: 초코 크런치 티라미수 롤 / 냉장 보관
총평(⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️)

8. 31:16 (라임차)
가게명: 爷爷不泡茶
* 메뉴: 初恋玫瑰青提
    * 특징: 청포도+장미 음료 / 중컵 / 70% 당도 / 펄 추가

2. 달걀, 설탕, 소금을 섞고, 버터우유를 조금씩 넣어가며 반죽을 풀어줍니다.

4. 버터를 바른 틀에 80 ~ 90%만 채워 굽습니다.
5. 오븐: 170 ~ 200℃에서 25 ~ 40분, 에어프라이어: 160 ~ 175℃에서 20 ~ 35분을 기준으로 색/중앙 탄력으로 조절합니다.

참고로 버터떡은 따뜻하게 먹어야 맛있는 것 같아요!

en-US.title: Making butter rice cakes with a gay friend at 4 AM (feat. Kim Ddol-ddol)
en-US.description:
I just whipped this up so quickly, so I'll just write the recipe down separately... heh.

(But strangely enough, it tasted good.)

1. Melt butter and milk over low heat or in a microwave (without boiling) to lukewarm.

2. Mix the eggs, sugar, and salt, then gradually add the buttermilk while loosening the dough.

3. Sift glutinous rice flour (or tapioca starch if needed) and baking powder into the mixture and blend until smooth and lump-free.

4. Fill a buttered mold 80–90% full and bake.

5. Oven: 170–200°C for 25–40 minutes; Air fryer: 160–175°C for 20–35 minutes; adjust based on color and firmness in the center.

For reference, I think butter rice cakes taste best when eaten warm!

I ate cold butter rice cakes in Shanghai, and they didn't taste good, so I wondered why they were trending? I tried it, and the warm butter rice cake was actually pretty good haha..

en-US.title: I went on a trip to Hong Kong with my best friend, Gesachin.
en-US.description:
Hello..ㅎ
Thanks to my friend Ddoldol, I was able to go to Hong Kong!

This trip to Hong Kong was for the MAMA event,
but as many of you know, there was a fire in Hong Kong the day before..ㅠ

So, the event was held in a very solemn atmosphere overall.

According to the Hong Kong MAMA staff,
they felt the quick coordination and attention to detail put into the overall event in Korea,
and there were many positive comments from locals who appreciated the excellent response..!
So, I was secretly proud,
and more than anything, I was relieved that it all ended safely.ㅎ

While in Hong Kong, I only ate hot pot.

(Of course... the hot pot was delicious.)
If I go back next time,
I want to try more of everything and enjoy it more leisurely.ㅎㅎㅎㅎ

Thank you for joining us on our trip today.
See you next time. Hehe

Well, hello~~~~~~
